complaints.title: Live wire sparking near school gate
complaints.description: Exposed overhead wire is sparking after rain. Children pass this gate throughout the day.
complaints.ai: Immediate public safety risk: live electrical hazard near a school. Route to Electrical Department within 30 minutes.

complaints.title: Overflowing garbage point
complaints.description: Garbage pile is overflowing into the road and attracting stray animals.
complaints.ai: High density commercial area with repeat reports and sanitation risk. Prioritize today.
